values: Passive animals are included here so they do not inflate the Tier 1 enemy list. Harvest yields are before tool modifiers.
Tier tabs separate combat tier, not only map location. Matriarch nests are Tier 2 objects encountered inside a Tier 5 fight.
An archetype appears on every tier where its normal spawn rules permit it. Those rows are scaled variants, not additional unique enemy designs.
Surface zones currently run T1 meadows, T2 woodland, T3 outskirts/highway, T4 city. Tier 5 is reserved for high-tier depths and bosses.
Visual walker outfits: Valley drifter (T1), Woodland logger (T2), Highway worker (T3), Office revenant / Security guard (T4), plus night models. Outfit alone does not define a new stat block.
Ecology specials require matching habitats and tier ranges. Pale Hunter is night-only above ground; suitable Tier 5 underground areas bypass the night requirement.
The night population selects a stalker or night bloater, but ecology can replace a spawn with an eligible specialist. Night-flagged specialists gain the flag speed/reward modifiers too.
Standard infected pursuit gains 25% at night. Ordinary displayed daytime speeds exclude this bonus; the named night variants already include it.
Stalker/bloater spawn health is overwritten by ConfigureSpecial; the sheets use the final ExpeditionCampaign.Hp value, not the earlier AddEnemy default.
Ordinary bite damage is 7 + 3 × tier before mitigation. Special attacks have separate values. Wounds and hazard damage are additional to the basic attack column.
Standard rewards: character XP 20 + 8 × tier; eligible T2+ kills can award a matching-tier registry gun at a hash roll of 1 in 5; otherwise some rolls award provisions/ammo.
Night reward flags add 1 or 2 catalysts and a provision; specialist bonuses stack where applicable. Worms, wildlife, humans and bosses use separate reward paths.
Story guardians and human combatants are conditional. The sheets identify their actual combat tier, not a moral classification as permanently hostile.
Seed 431 is used only for the two location-scaled vignette guardians. Their tier can vary with the local zone in another world.
Repeated field-site guards, rescue waves, dungeon guards, mission targets and boss adds use the listed base templates; they are not separate archetypes.
Safe-room and fever-mother HP overrides are included. Only currently spawned actors are counted; described story figures that have no combat actor are not invented as enemies.
